sources.citation: Fu et al., Do More Agents Help? Controlled and Protocol-Aligned Evaluation of LLM Agent Workflows, arXiv:2606.05670
sources.projection: Controlled same-substrate comparisons show that adding multi-agent scaffolding does not reliably beat a matched single-agent anchor and can worsen accuracy-cost tradeoffs.
sources.cannot_see: Does not by itself determine which RAKL cognitive operations benefit from which targeted compensators.

sources.citation: Dastidar, Where Does Agent Reliability Come From?, arXiv:2607.17044
sources.projection: A production system reports system-level reliability gains and decomposes contributions from scaffolding, routing, specialists and verification; attribution remains partly unresolved in some settings.
sources.cannot_see: Proprietary specialists/data and unmatched generic-scaffold baselines limit independent mechanism attribution.

sources.citation: Han, Buntine, Shareghi, VerifiAgent: a Unified Verification Agent in Language Model Reasoning, Findings of EMNLP 2025, DOI 10.18653/v1/2025.findings-emnlp.891
sources.projection: Verification can be adaptively routed across meta-verification and reasoning-type-specific external tools.
sources.cannot_see: Does not establish that one verifier architecture should govern all RAKL scientific tasks.

sources.citation: Yang et al., SWE-agent: Agent-Computer Interfaces Enable Automated Software Engineering, NeurIPS 2024, arXiv:2405.15793
sources.projection: The interface surrounding a language model materially changes what actions and repository operations the agent can perform effectively.
sources.cannot_see: Software-engineering interface gains do not imply universal benefits for scientific-research cognition.

sources.citation: Xia et al., Agentless: Demystifying LLM-based Software Engineering Agents, arXiv:2407.01489
sources.projection: A comparatively simple staged workflow can compete with more complex autonomous agent systems, making simple interpretable pipelines a serious baseline.
sources.cannot_see: Evidence is software-engineering specific and does not identify the best abstraction for RAKL research tasks.

novelty_boundary: RAKL does not claim invention of scaffolding, decomposition, routing, verification, multi-agent systems, specialist models, external memory or interfaces. The candidate contribution is the evidence-governed treatment of capability shaping as an atomic method object with explicit strength/failure contracts, resource-sensitive attribution, blocking validity constraints, frozen matched-model ablations and negative-result preservation.
